create_ping_pong_scenario: create a gRPC performance benchmark ping pong scenario config dict with custom rpc type and client settings
remove_nonproto_fields_scenario: remove non-protobuf fields like CATEGORIES and CLIENT_LANGUAGE from a scenario config dict
generate_geometric_progression: generate a geometric progression sequence of integers from a start value to a stop value
build_payload_config: build a payload config dict with bytebuf or simple params for request and response sizes
iterate_cxx_scenarios: iterate over all C++ gRPC performance benchmark scenarios using the CXXLanguage class scenarios generator
